title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime Streams New Music Videos
content:
The official YouTube channel for the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime began streaming on Tuesday a new music video directed by Jack-Amin Ibrahim (key animator for One Piece Heroines , One Piece Fan Letter ) that centers on Weak Kingsley and Avida. The music video is set to the anime's ending theme song "Watson" by Petite Meller ft Oslo Green:

The staff also streamed an animated music video featuring "High Forever" (Marlon Hoffstadt Remix) by Marlon Hoffstadt and Petite Miller:

The staff describes the series:

It presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge. When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

The casts include (Japanese/English):

• Momoka Terasawa/Valeria Rodriguez as Roman Carax

• Akari Kitō/Kimoy Lee as Talia Yang

• Kōki Uchiyama/Nazeeh Tarsha as D

• Kentarō Tone/Clancy Brown as Weak Kingsley

Kai Ikarashi (who was a storyboard artist, animation director, animator, and prop designer for the first series) helmed the new series in his directorial debut. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners producer and writer Bartosz Sztybor again worked on the series, and Ichigo Kanno (animation director and key animator on the first series) was the lead character designer. Masahiko Otsuka returned as the scriptwriter.

The new anime's opening theme song is The Cure 's 1978 song "10:15 Saturday Night," and the ending theme song is Petite Meller 's "Watson." Rapper RICO NASTY wrote and performed "YOU CAN'T RUN FROM ME" for the anime, and it appeared in the second teaser trailer.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , the anime series by Studio Trigger based on CD PROJEKT RED 's Cyberpunk 2077 game, debuted on Netflix in September 2022. The game is itself based on Mike Pondsmith 's Cyberpunk tabletop RPG game series.

Aniplex of America released the series on a complete Blu-ray Disc set in North America in October 2025. Anime Limited and Plaion Pictures released the series on home video in Europe, and Sugoi Co released the series on home video in Australia and New Zealand.

A prequel manga titled Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness from artist Asano ( BNA: Brand New Animal manga) and writer Bartosz Sztybor ( CD PROJEKT RED ) launched on the Comic Alive+ website in December 2024, and is getting a release in seven languages aside from Japanese. Dark Horse is releasing the series in English in print.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Producers Confirm Pavi’s Avatar Cycle Status After Finale
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has completely opened up its post-apocalyptic world with the final episodes of its debut season , and the producers behind it all have revealed Pavi’s status with the Avatar Cycle following the events of the finale. The final few episodes of the debut season came with some big reveals for Pavi. Not only did she find out more about her past, but she also found a new direction to follow on her Avatar journey through the rest of the series moving forward.

Avatar: Seven Havens saw Pavi reach a new level of understanding with her abilities as she was able to see constellations of past Avatars such as Kyoshi, Aang and most notably, Korra. This had fans wondering if Pavi had been able to reconnect to the Avatar Cycle after Korra had severed the connection during her time , but co-creator Michael DiMartino and executive producer Sehaj Sethi confirmed to IGN that this was not the case, “It’s something else,” DiMartino stated. “She has not reconnected. It can’t happen that easily.”

Avatar: Seven Havens Producers Confirm Pavi Has Not Reconnected to the Avatar Cycle

“It’s something else,” Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise co-creator Michael DiMartino confirmed when asked if Pavi had reconnected to the Avatar Cycle after Korra had severed the connection in The Legend of Korra. “She has not reconnected. It can’t happen that easily. So she does have a connection with Korra, but the other stuff’s more of a vision.” As Sehaj further explains Pavi seeing these constellation forms in the final episodes, it turns out that this is still a form of incomplete connection with the past Avatars .

“That’s something we really had to work [on showing] visually that the connection is not complete,” Sehaj revealed. “It was not just, oh, let’s show Korra for a second or something. It was like, hey, she’s sort of faded, right? She’s not completely there. We wanted it to not just be so easy as, yup, now Korra can talk to you . That’s something that still needs to progress in the series.” But with this in mind, it’s clearly something we’ll see develop further over the course of the series’ four season run.

What’s Next for Avatar: Seven Havens ?

If you wanted to catch up with Avatar: Seven Havens now that the first season has ended its run, you can find the 13 episode debut season now streaming with Paramount+. Book Two of the series has been confirmed for 13 episodes as well, but it has not revealed any release date information as of this time. The series has also revealed that it has been renewed for Seasons 3 and 4 as well, but the producers behind it all have confirmed that this will be the full scope of the series (and it makes it like it four season long predecessors).

Sehaj previously confirmed to ComicBook that Avatar: Seven Havens Season 3 and 4 are already in production as of this time as well, and voice stars Saheli Khan (Pavi) and Aishu Devan (Nisha) have teased that the twins will be going through a lot of “character development” following the end of the first season too. The ball is moving fast with this one, so how are you feeling about Avatar: Seven Havens right now? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – IGN

title: Exclusive: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Omake Shorts Premieres on HIDIVE on November 6, Key Visual and Trailer Revealed
content:
I’m Dating a Dark Summoner Omake Shorts will premiere exclusively on HIDIVE on November 6 as a 12-episode bonus series based on the Fall 2026 anime I’m Dating a Dark Summoner .

The short-form series reimagines Amona, Roni, and the rest of the cast in chibi-style sketch comedy scenarios. The characters will appear in different settings and roles, including stories set at a cafe, an office, and a school. An official English-subtitled trailer was also released alongside the announcement, which Anime Corner has the exclusive opportunity to share:

The returning cast includes:

• Rei Takano as Amona

• Yuki Nishiyama as Roni

• Semmai Hodentei as Imp

Acali Arimiya is directing the shorts and also serves as character designer. Arimiya is co-writing the scripts with Araki Humisato, while production is handled by WWWave Corporation’s Deregula animation studio. You can see the key visual below.

The main I’m Dating a Dark Summoner anime is an adaptation from the fantasy romantic comedy manga written and illustrated by Shaoh. The Omake Shorts will be available to HIDIVE subscribers in supported markets, including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand.

title: Naruto Live-Action Movie Confirms Filming Starts Soon With New Sony Team Up
content:
Naruto is now in the works on a brand new live-action feature film from the director behind Spider-Man: Brand New Da y , and now the project is getting a boost from Sony Pictures as production has been confirmed to kick off very soon. Sony Pictures has quite a few anime live-action adaptations in the midst of production as they continue to expand into the world of anime with future projects, and now they are teaming up with Lionsgate on the release of what could be the biggest live-action anime feature yet.

According to a new report from The Hollywood Reporter , Sony Pictures is now officially teaming up with Lionsgate to co-finance the movie and oversee the film’s international distribution. Lionsgate will oversee the production, domestic region release, and is now slated for a Spring 2027 start of production. This further lines up with reports for the movie’s worldwide casting search that proposed an early 2027 start date for filming for those involved as well.

What to Know for Naruto ‘s Live-Action Movie

Following his blockbuster success with Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Destin Daniel Cretton will be directing the new live-action Naruto movie for Lionsgate Pictures and Sony Pictues. Cretton is also co-writing the new movie together with Tasha Huo, and is a co-producer alongside Jeyun Munford through Hisako with Avi Arad, Ari Arad and Emmy Yu of Arad Productions, and Jeremy Latcham. With Cretton recently signing a new overall deal with Sony Pictures for three years following Spider-Man’ s success, this production slots right into the window.

A worldwide casting search for the main trio of Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, and Sakura Harada is now underway, and Charles Melton has been rumored to have joined the cast as Kakashi Hatake. Reports have teased that the characters’ ages might not fully line up with the original incarnations of the series. Other reports have noted that there might also be other notable changes to each character , but without it even being in production yet it’s hard to nail down which of these reports will end up being the most correct at the end of the day. Thankfully it seems we won’t have to wait too much longer for it all.

When Does Naruto’ s Live-Action Movie Come Out?

If production truly does go as scheduled and begins next Spring, there’s a chance fans will see the new movie in action in 2028. Cretton has been working together with original creator Masashi Kishimoto on the new adaptation, and even noted as such in a message to fans during New York Comic Con 2026 earlier this Fall . “We’re approaching the world, relationships, and journeys Kishimoto-sensei created with a lot of care, and we want to capture what makes NARUTO so special,” Cretton stated at the time.

Naruto itself is also in the midst of a massive comeback. The franchise has launched Project Rasengan, a new effort to release new projects across video game, manga, and anime formats. This is resulting in a new crossover anime special now in the works, and Kishimoto himself is returning for a new Naruto manga that fans will get more information on later this year at Jump Festa 2027 . But are you ready for Naruto’ s live-action movie debut? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – The Hollywood Reporter

title: Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Confirms Netflix Release Date With New Teaser – Watch
content:
Blue Eye Samurai is one of the most anticipated franchises coming back to Netflix next year, and now a release date has been set for Season 2 with a new teaser trailer helping to show it all off. Blue Eye Samurai originally made its debut with Netflix in 2023 , and quickly became one of the most successful new series premieres with the streamer. Going on to win some big awards that year, it was no surprise to find out that a second season was already in the works.

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 previously revealed it was slated to make its worldwide debut with Netflix sometime in January as part of a way to kick off the new year for the streaming service, but a new update from Netflix has now confirmed that the new season will be premiering on January 19th. To celebrate the confirmation of the new season’s release date, Netflix has dropped a new teaser for Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 with some new footage. Check it out in action below.

When Does Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Come Out on Netflix?

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 will be making its worldwide debut with Netflix on January 19th next year , but has yet to confirm how many episodes the new season will be running for. Created by Amber Noizumi and Michael Green, who also serve as writers and executive producers on the series, animation for the series is produced by Blue Spirit. Erwin Stoff serves as an executive producer with Jane Wu as supervising director and producer. Maya Erskine also leads the returning voice cast as Mizu.

Others expected to return from the first season include Brenda Song as Akemi, Darren Barnet as Taigen, Masi Oka as Ringo, and Kenneth Branagh as Abijah Fowler. New additions to the voice cast confirmed for the new season are Jonathan Pryce as Old Violet, Joel Kim Booster as Priest Ando, and Sherry Cola as Kuma. As the teaser suggests, Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 will be heading to London as Mizu seeks out the next phase of her bloody revenge.

What’s Next for Blue Eye Samurai’ s Future?

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 is the beginning of the end as Netflix has also confirmed that a third and final season of the animated series is now in the works . A release date has naturally not yet been revealed for this final season, but it’s going to serve as the grand finale for Noizumi and Green’s overall story. Outside of the fact that it’s been teased for a release in 2028, the creators told Netflix as such, “From our first episode, we knew how Mizu’s journey would eventually end — we just never knew whether we’d be lucky enough to have the chance to get her there. Well, we got lucky!”

The creators also addressed the three year wait for the second season too , “First, we want to thank all of our viewers for waiting. Your enthusiasm is what energized us and helped us get here,” the creators began. “Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither were 17th-century London or Edo Japan. The care that every single member of our team poured into researching those worlds, then crafting them brushstroke by brushstroke into breathtaking, moving art is nothing short of a miracle to us.”

title: New Girls Band Cry Anime Film's Teaser Unveils May 21 Opening
content:
A teaser video and key visual for Girls Band Cry the Movie , the brand-new film for the Girls Band Cry anime, debuted on Tuesday, and the teaser announces that Toei will open the film on May 21, 2027. The teaser also teases that the TOGENASHI TOGEARI band is going on a national tour in the film's story.

The website confirmed the returning cast, as well as the returning staff:

• Director: Kazuo Sakai

• Screenplay: Jukki Hanada

• Music Producer: Kenji Tamai (agehasprings)

• Music: Yūsuke Tanaka (agehasprings)

• Character Design: nari Teshima

• CG Directors: Jae Hoon Jung, Daiki Nakazawa

The website also announced that the anime will receive a stage production from March 21 to 28 at Ikebukuro's Sunshine Theatre in Tokyo. The real-life TOGENASHI TOGEARI band will perform a concert at the K-Arena Yokohama on March 20.

The main character drops out of high school in her second year, and aims at entering a university while working alone in Tokyo. A girl is betrayed by her friends and doesn't know what to do. Another girl is abandoned by her parents, and tries to survive in the city by doing part-time jobs. This world lets us down all the time. Nothing goes as planned. But we want something that we can continue to like. We believe there's a place where we belong. That's why we sing.

The Girls Band Cry television anime premiered in April 2024 and aired for 13 episodes. Toei Animation released the anime in English digitally in North America in August 2024. Crunchyroll started streaming the series in November 2024.

The anime already received a two-film compilation. The first film Seishun Kyо̄sо̄kyoku opened on October 3, 2025, and the second film Naa, Mirai. opened on November 14, 2025.

Indonesia's Catchplay+ streaming service began streaming the anime on May 31, 2024 with both Indonesian and English subtitles, making it the first service anywhere in the world to have English subtitles officially available for the anime. Thai distributor Cartoon Club announced in late June 2024 it would begin streaming the anime in July, and the anime will have a Thai dub , making the stream the first announced international dub for the title.

The staff announced in July 2024 that cast members Mirei and Natsu were going on a temporary hiatus due to health reasons. The remaining three main cast members — Rina , Yuri , and Syuri — would continue performing. Mirei and Natsu returned to dialogue recording work by April 2025. and the new film credits all five members.

A game titled Girls Band Cry First Riff is also in development. A separate game titled Momoka (o) Wasshoi (Momoka Heave-Ho) launched for PC via Steam on September 28 (September 29 in Japan), 2025.

title: emaqi Service Adds Naruto, Kaiju No. 8, Spy x Family, 2 More Viz Media Titles; 8 New Exclusive Manga
content:
AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Tuesday that its emaqi e-bookstore service is adding eight new exclusive titles this month. Five of the new titles will be available through its " emaqi Premium" monthly subscription service. Additionally, five manga titles published by Viz Media have also been added to the " emaqi Premium" service: Naruto , Kaiju No. 8 , Black Torch , SPY x FAMILY , and Dr. Stone .

Title: How Did We Even Do It?! (18+) Author: Keigo Hayasaka Release Date: November 3 Synopsis: We need to do it, but we just don't know how. The sexless situation that every long-term couple runs into!! Daiya and Lino are a close couple: seven years dating, and five years living together. They're already like family to each other and at the point where they're both thinking about marriage. But the truth is, they've been in a sexless relationship for two whole years... Between juggling busy work schedules and missing every possible chance, the mood just never seemed to strike... So will they do it or won't they? Will they get married while still in this sexless situation, or not? A delicate but very real problem between men and women, drawn with a comic touch.

Title: I'd Rather Die Than Call You Cute! Author: Mashimi Mori Release Date: November 6 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Yoi Amakuni, a flawless beauty who excels at both academics and athletics, headed to her classroom expecting a dazzling high school debut. But during self-introductions, what set the room buzzing wasn't her cuteness... it was tough-looking Onizuka declaring, "I'm going to be the heroine of this school"...?! His unpredictable words and actions shake Yoi, along with the school's time-honored "Miss Heroine" contest! In the end, which of them is more worthy of the title of heroine...?

Title: Kirin (18+) Author: Showhei Halumoto ( Shōhei Harumoto ) Release Date: November 6 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: You can hear the pulse of the engine. Scorching breath blasts from the exhaust. It burns, it roars, it accelerates...!! A high-octane family saga fueled by motorcycles. A timeless ode to motorcycles and the men who never stop riding!

Title: Higanjima : Isle of Vampires (18+) Author: Kōji Matsumoto Release Date: November 13 Synopsis: Higanjima—a remote island where vampires dwell. Set foot there, and there's no coming back alive... Akira Miyamoto has just earned his place at college. But two years ago, his older brother vanished without a trace. The truth: he'd been carried off to Higanjima, and has been surviving there in hiding, alone, ever since. Then one day, a mysterious beauty appears before Akira—holding his missing brother's driver's license. It's a summons to the dreaded island... and the curtain rises on a loathsome nightmare. A spine-chilling vampire survival horror!!

Title: Bachi-Bachi BURST Author: Takahiro Satō Release Date: November 20 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: Koitaro has grown by leaps and bounds as a sumo wrestler, and now he's got two new junior disciples at Kuryu stable: a cocky college grad and a chubby otaku shut-in. Meanwhile, his old rival Oko has moved up into that same division!! The blazing sumo epic " Bachi Bachi " takes its story into a whole new ring!!

Title: Cigarette and Cherry Author: Daishiro Kawakami Release Date: November 20 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: After our protagonist makes his college debut and vows to find a girlfriend, who should appear before him but a beautiful, cigarette-smoking senpai! Faced with the obvious virgin's various approaches, Senpai continues to handle each one with skill and grace...! An awkward romantic comedy between a beautiful senior and a virgin junior!

Title: The Witch of Schluss (18+) Author: Mizue Odawara Release Date: November 24 ( emaqi Premium) Synopsis: From Mizue Odawara , author of "Taisho Romanchica" and " Hatsukoi Double Edge ," comes a true fantasy romance!! Vi is a failure of a witch. Yuri, the young man who saved her, is a demon guard from a distinguished noble family. Their attraction is mutual, but so are the secrets...!? A heart-pounding love story spun around a witch's "blood"!!

Title: How the Banished Duke's Daughter, Vilhelmiina, Found Her Happiness: The Strongest Commoner Sparks a Revolution Author(s): Gyo Tadano (original story), Kazuno Yuikawa (original character design), 4U (manga) Release Date: November 27 Synopsis: Vilhelmiina was born into the House of Perikunen, one of the kingdom's foremost noble houses. Educated to become queen and raised as the noblest of nobles, she is forced to marry a commoner—all so that her fiancé, the Crown Prince, can justify his infidelity. But her new husband, Aleksi, has a brilliant mind, and his research could overturn everything the world takes for granted. Look closely, and he's a diamond in the rough as a man, too, just waiting to be polished. Gradually adjusting to commoner life with an open mind, Vilhelmiina takes Aleksi in hand, honing him in both body and mind, and begins plotting her revenge on the royal family and her own ducal house for so unjustly casting her out of noble society!

Orange Inc. was founded in April 2021, and announced in July 2023 it had raised US$1.8 million. The company established its headquarters in the U.S. in March 2024.

Orange Inc. launched the app version of emaqi in May 2025.

The emaqi Premium monthly subscription launched on July 1.

title: Mari Okada, Makoto Ojiro's Sister Resistar Manga Ends in 2 Chapters
content:
This year's 49th issue of Shogakukan 's Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Mari Okada and Makoto Ojiro 's Sistar Resistar manga will end in two chapters. The manga's next chapter will run in the magazine's 51st issue on November 16. If there are no delays, the manga will end on November 23.

The manga centers on Akira Nitta, the eldest daughter of the Nitta family. The family once ran an entire idol business, with Akira sewing the clothes, the father working the lights, Akira's younger brother playing the music, and Akira's younger sister singing and dancing as the idol talent herself. Though Akira wished that such idyllic days could go on forever, it was not to be, and a series of unfortunate events brings their dream to an end. But when Akira sees footage of an idol performance while working, her life begins to turn again.

Okada and Ojiro launched the manga in Big Comic Spirits in September 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's fourth compiled book volume on August 28, and will release the fifth volume on January 29.

Mari Okada is known for writing anime featuring relationships with highly charged interpersonal drama, often between teenagers, and often featuring taboo topics or relationships. Her melodrama often works to emphasize the difficulty of human relationships and connection. Some of her signature anime works include anohana , Toradora! , O Maidens in Your Savage Season (also based on a manga she wrote), Anthem of the Heart , Her Blue Sky , Hana-Saku Iroha , A Lull in the Sea , Lupin III: The Woman Called Fujiko Mine , and Kiznaiver , among many others. She made her anime directorial debut with Maquia , and most recently directed the 2023 film maboroshi . Most recently, she penned the script for the anime film Fureru. in October 2024, which she produced alongside her frequent Super Peace Busters creative team, with whom she worked on Toradora! , anohana , and Anthem of the Heart .

Ojiro launched the Insomniacs After School manga in Weekly Big Comic Spirits in May 2019, and ended it in August 2023. Shogakukan published the manga's 14th and final compiled book volume in October 2023. Viz Media licensed the manga in English and released the 14th volume on June 23.

The Insomniacs After School manga inspired an anime adaptation that premiered in Japan in April 2023. HIDIVE streamed the series as it aired in Japan. The music video for rock band Macaroni Enpitsu 's "Enshin" (Centrifuge) song featured art from the manga in 2019.

The Insomniacs After School manga also inspired a live-action film that opened in Japan in June 2023.

title: 'Kawaii dake ja Nai Shikimori-san' Creator Begins 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Manga Adaptation
content:
Manga creator Keigo Maki ( Kawaii dake ja Nai Shikimori-san ) will draw a manga adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel, the official X (formerly Twitter) account of the manga announced on Tuesday. The series will begin serialization in Weekly Shounen Magazine 's 50th issue on November 11.

Kinoko Nasu ( Fate/stay night ) and Type-Moon are credited for the original work, while Hirokazu Koyama ( 22/7 ) is credited for the original character designs.

ufotable —the animation studio behind the Kara no Kyoukai ( The Garden of Sinners ) film series and Fate/stay night Movie: Heaven's Feel trilogy—is producing a theatrical anime film adaptation . The film is scheduled to premiere in Japan on November 20.

The original visual novel was developed by Type-Moon, with Kinoko Nasu serving as the scenario writer and director, and Hirokazu Koyama credited for character design, original art, and graphic direction. It was originally released for Windows in April 2012. An enhanced edition featuring full voice acting and HD visuals was released for PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in December 2022, followed by a Steam release in December 2023.

A light novel adaptation written by Kinoko Nasu and illustrated by Hirokazu Koyama was released under the Seikasha Fictions imprint on August 27. The second volume released on September 30, with the third volume scheduled for a November 10 release.

Maki is best known for Kawaii dake ja Nai Shikimori-san ( Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie ), which ran on the Magazine pocket platform from February 2019 to February 2023. Kodansha published the 20th and final volume in April 2023.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in March 2020 and released the 20th volume in April 2025.

A 12-episode television anime adaptation by Doga Kobo aired in Spring 2022. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime worldwide, excluding Asia.

Announcement

Official manga X: @ mahoyo_comic

title: Ramparts of Ice Manga Gets Epilogue Chapter in Fan Book
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kōcha Agasawa 's The Ramparts of Ice ( Koori no Jyōheki or Ice Castle Wall ) manga announced on October 29 that the manga will have a fan book that will ship on January 4, and the fan book will include an exclusive new epilogue chapter set after the main manga series' final chapter.

The manga centers on Koyuki Hikawa, an aloof high school student who has a hard time getting close to others, and who builds a wall between herself and other people. Although she spends her time alone at school, for some reason Minato Amemiya keeps getting closer to her. The frustrating story of youth follows the lives of four somewhat complicated individuals: Koyuki and Minato, plus the popular girl Miki and the laid-back boy Yōta.

Agasawa ( You and I Are Polar Opposites ) originally serialized the manga as a webtoon on the LINE Manga app from January 2020 to April 2022. Shueisha published the manga's 14th and final compiled volume (with the manga reorganized for this print volume format) in February 2025.

The manga ranked at #15 for male readers in the 2024 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2023, and also was nominated for the 69th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2023. The manga placed second in May 2024 in the "Vertical Scroll Comic" section of the second Rakuten Kobo E-book Awards. Additionally, the manga ranked #2 on AnimeJapan's sixth "Most Wanted Anime Adaptation" poll in 2023.

The first season of the manga's television anime debuted on April 2. Netflix streamed the anime worldwide. The second season debuted on October 1, and is ongoing. Netflix is once again streaming the anime.
